title_sq: Ne Myslym Shyr, Prapa Shkolles Pjeter Budi, Shitet Garsoniere E Investuar Totalisht!
description_sq: Ne Myslym Shyr, prapa Shkolles Pjeter Budi, Shitet Garsoniere e Investuar Totalisht. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e trete te nje prej godinave ekzistuese 5 kateshe me siperfaqe neto prej 30 m2 dhe organizohet nga ambienti i ndenjes, tualeti me dritare dhe ballkoni. Garsonierja eshte totalisht e investuar nga e para duke filluar nga instalimet elektrike dhe hidraulike te reja, parket, vetrata plastike dopjo xham, dyert e brendshme dhe e jashtme. Gjithashtu ky apartament eshte nje mundesi shume e mire si per banim edhe per investim pasi kerkesat per qira jane shume te larta. Prona disponon dokumetacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: In Myslym Shyr, Behind Pjeter Budi School, Fully Invested Studio for Sale!
description_en: In Myslym Shyr, behind Pjeter Budi School, fully invested studio for sale. The apartment is located on the third floor of one of the existing 5-story buildings with a net area of ​​30 m2 and is organized by the living room, the toilet with window and the balcony. The studio is completely invested from scratch, starting with new electrical and plumbing installations, parquet, double-glazed plastic windows, internal and external doors. Also, this apartment is a very good opportunity both for housing and for investment, since the rent requirements are very high. The property has regular mortgage documentation.
